items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: The man's name was Shep Kelly... I went to work there... and I met an awful lot of people

ctx.x: No, it was called Kelly's. Shep Kelly, this was a place down in Chinatown, Shep Kelly. Was it Shep's? No, that was Shep's Playhouse.
I've heard that Shep's Playhouse was down in --
